description: Travis Central Appraisal District EARS submissions for tax years 2022 to 2025 (one source per year). See docs/registry/texas-sources.md, 'Prior-year rolls'.

sources.license: Public record; no license or terms of use stated for the exports (the privacy policy covers website use only)
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: Tax year 2022: TCAD posts no prior-year Legacy 8.0.33 appraisal export; the only prior-year roll on publicinformation is the '2022 EARS Submission' (the electronic appraisal roll TCAD submits to the Comptroller), under the same host and path (wp-content/largefiles/) as the 2026 exports of tx-travis-cad, whose terms were reviewed 2026-11-02 (not re-read for this entry). HEAD 2026-11-10: 200, 149,778,982 B, Last-Modified Mon, 23 Jan 2023. LAYOUT DIFFERS from the PACS export of the current roll: EARS follows the Comptroller's Electronic Appraisal Roll Submission manual (96-1051). tx_travis --history-only reads its county AJR records as market value history only (no owner, address or other fact); values are the roll as submitted on the date in the file name. robots.txt: Crawl-delay 10 (honoured), Disallow empty. A Public Information Act request for prior-year Legacy exports is the alternative route.
